programs.title: A Vineyard Romance
programs.desc: When Seattle magazine writer Samantha Hart is sent home to write an article about the wedding destination of Hawthorne Vineyards, she discovers the ex who broke her heart not only runs the vineyard, but he's about to get married there.

programs.title: Been There All Along
programs.desc: After her public breakup, Charley, determined founder of a dating app, is near bankruptcy. She teams up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

programs.title: Love at the Bootcamp
programs.desc: A scattered marketing executive is tasked with helping an unpopular small-town bootcamp turn its image around. She finds that the strict, regimented ways of its owner might just be the perfect 'fit' for love.

programs.title: Lease on Love
programs.desc: Poppy is a marketing specialist whose life is turned upside down when she fakes an engagement with her boss's handsome new client Milo, to win over her strict building manager and get Milo the penthouse suite.

programs.title: Love & Where to Find It
programs.desc: Two local coffee shop owners despise each other but begin to fall in love while sending each other messages on their friends' behalf.

programs.title: Mystic
programs.desc: A betrayal by Tom shatters the KP team, jeopardizing their chance of competing at The Champs; Caleb and Mitch investigate Gordon; Issie finally speaks her mind to Dan.
